key_concepts: Different weather conditions include sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, and stormy.
Sunny weather has a clear sky, visible Sun, no rain, and hot bright conditions.
Rainy weather has rain, dark clouds, covered Sun, wet surroundings, and slightly cold air.
Cloudy weather has many puffy or layered clouds that may be low, middle, or high.
Windy weather has blowing wind, swaying leaves and branches, moving clouds, and cool air.
Weather changes within a day, such as temperature changing from cool to warm.
Weather changes from day to day and can be recorded using weather symbols.
Weather can be predicted by observing weather patterns over several days.
Local weather type is the most common weather observed over a period of time.
